description.narrative: IFC is providing up to EUR 100 mn or TRY equivalent in the form of a senior, unsecured corporate loan (IFC Loan) to Dogus Otomotiv Servis ve Ticaret A.S. (Dogus Otomotiv, DOAS, or the Company), a new IFC client. The IFC Loan will be used to finance the Companys purchase of electric vehicles (EV), thereby reducing the proportion of Internal Combustion Engine (ICE), and for working capital and/or other corporate needs.

Project Outcomes: Economy-wide effects: The Project will support the continued growth of the automotive industry in Türkiye by (i) increasing demand for EVs; (ii) increasing demand for goods and services provided by local suppliers; and (iii) creating more skilled new employment opportunities. Environmental effects: The Project will contribute to increasing energy efficiency and GHG emission reduction by supporting the dissemination of EVs in the Turkish automotive market. Market Creation: Competitiveness: IFC anticipates the Project to enhance the competitiveness of the automotive retail industry through demonstration and replication channels. The Project will enable the Company to increase its EV sales at scale, which will support the distribution of a more efficient and environmentally sustainable product in the market. As the Company is the third largest automotive retailer in Türkiye, the Project should serve as a catalyst for other firms to also enter and expand its EV operations to remain competitive. Sustainability: IFC anticipates the Project to contribute to greater environmental sustainability in the automotive retail market through demonstration and replication channels. The Project is expected to catalyze the adoption of resource efficient solutions among other automotive suppliers in Türkiye.
